Title: Owner successfully edits assignment metadata
Preconditions: 1. User is logged in as project owner | 2. Project has an active assignment | 3. Navigate to Project Details page
Steps: 1. Locate the Assignment section | 2. Click "Edit Assignment" button | 3. Modify freelancerName to "Jane Smith" | 4. Modify description to "Updated detailed project requirements with new scope" | 5. Add notes "Client requested scope expansion" | 6. Click "Save Changes" button
Test Data: freelancerName: "Jane Smith" | description: "Updated detailed project requirements with new scope" (50+ chars) | notes: "Client requested scope expansion"
Expected Result: Assignment card displays updated freelancerName, description, and notes. Edit form closes. Success feedback shown. No errors displayed.

Title: Complete edit flow from view to save
Preconditions: 1. User authenticated as owner | 2. Assignment exists for project | 3. On Project Details page at /project/:id
Steps: 1. Scroll to Assignment section (#assignment) | 2. Verify assignment details displayed in read-only card | 3. Click "Edit Assignment" button | 4. Verify form pre-populates with current values | 5. Change description from original to "Enhanced description with at least ten characters" | 6. Submit form | 7. Verify card shows new description | 8. Refresh page | 9. Verify changes persisted
Test Data: Original description: "Build mobile app" | New description: "Enhanced description with at least ten characters" | freelancerName unchanged
Expected Result: Edit button replaced with form. Form pre-fills correctly. On save, form closes and card updates. After refresh, updated data persists. PUT /api/assignments/:id called successfully.

Title: Edit with minimum valid description length
Preconditions: 1. Logged in as project owner | 2. Active assignment exists
Steps: 1. Click "Edit Assignment" | 2. Clear description field | 3. Enter exactly 10 characters "Ten chars!" | 4. Click "Save Changes"
Expected Result: Assignment saves successfully with 10-character description. No validation error. Card updates correctly.

Title: Edit only notes field while keeping other fields unchanged
Preconditions: 1. Owner logged in | 2. Assignment with existing notes present
Steps: 1. Click "Edit Assignment" | 2. Do not modify freelancerName or description | 3. Update notes field to "Additional project requirements documented" | 4. Save changes
Test Data: notes: "Additional project requirements documented" | freelancerName and description remain unchanged
Expected Result: Only notes field updates. FreelancerName and description unchanged. Notes display below description in card. PUT API call includes all three fields.

Title: Edit assignment with special characters in fields
Steps: 1. Open edit form | 2. Set freelancerName to "O'Brien-Smith" | 3. Set description to "Project includes: API integration, UI/UX design & testing (with 50% completion)" | 4. Set notes to "Client's email: test@example.com" | 5. Submit
Test Data: freelancerName: "O'Brien-Smith" | description: "Project includes: API integration, UI/UX design & testing (with 50% completion)" | notes: "Client's email: test@example.com"
Expected Result: All special characters (apostrophes, hyphens, colons, ampersands, parentheses, @ symbols) saved correctly. No character encoding issues. Fields display correctly in card view.

Title: Cancel edit without saving changes
Preconditions: 1. Owner on Project Details | 2. Assignment exists
Steps: 1. Click "Edit Assignment" | 2. Modify freelancerName to "Different Name" | 3. Modify description | 4. Click "Cancel" button
Test Data: freelancerName: "Different Name" (not saved) | Original values remain in assignment
Expected Result: Edit form closes. Original assignment data displayed unchanged in card. No API call made. Edit button becomes available again.

Title: Edit with empty freelancerName field
Steps: 1. Click "Edit Assignment" | 2. Clear freelancerName field completely | 3. Keep description valid (10+ chars) | 4. Attempt to save
Expected Result: Validation error "Freelancer name is required" displayed below freelancerName field. Form not submitted. Edit mode remains active. No API call made.

Title: Edit with description under 10 characters
Steps: 1. Open edit form | 2. Set description to "Too short" (9 chars) | 3. Click "Save Changes"
Expected Result: Validation error "Description must be at least 10 characters" shown below description field. Form submission blocked. Assignment unchanged.

Title: Edit with empty description field
Steps: 1. Click "Edit Assignment" | 2. Clear entire description field | 3. Leave freelancerName valid | 4. Submit form
Expected Result: Error message "Description is required" displayed. Form does not submit. Edit mode persists. Card data unchanged.

Title: Non-owner attempts to edit assignment via direct action
Preconditions: 1. User logged in as bidder (not owner) | 2. Assignment exists | 3. User on Project Details page
Steps: 1. Navigate to Assignment section | 2. Verify "Edit Assignment" button NOT visible | 3. (If testing via console/dev tools) attempt to trigger handleEditClick | 4. Verify no edit form appears
Expected Result: Edit button not rendered for non-owners. Edit form never appears. Assignment card remains read-only. UI properly enforces owner-only edit access.

Title: API error during assignment update
Preconditions: 1. Owner logged in | 2. Assignment exists | 3. Backend returns 500 error on PUT /api/assignments/:id
Steps: 1. Click "Edit Assignment" | 2. Make valid changes | 3. Submit form | 4. Simulate/trigger API error response
Test Data: Backend responds with 500 error and message: "Failed to update assignment"
Expected Result: Error message displayed: "Failed to update assignment". Edit form remains open with entered data intact. User can retry or cancel. Assignment card shows original data.

Title: Edit with whitespace-only fields
Steps: 1. Open edit form | 2. Set freelancerName to "   " (spaces only) | 3. Set description to "          " (10 spaces) | 4. Attempt to save
Expected Result: Validation errors triggered. FreelancerName error: "Freelancer name is required". Description error: "Description is required" (after trim check). Form not submitted.

Title: Edit assignment with extremely long input
Steps: 1. Click "Edit Assignment" | 2. Enter 500-character string in description | 3. Enter 100-character string in freelancerName | 4. Enter 200-character string in notes | 5. Save
Test Data: freelancerName: 100 chars | description: 500 chars | notes: 200 chars (all valid length strings)
Expected Result: Assignment saves successfully. Long text truncated or scrolled in display if needed. No character limit errors (unless backend enforces max). All data persists correctly.

Title: Edit assignment and immediately update stage afterward
Preconditions: 1. Owner logged in | 2. Assignment with currentStage "NotStarted"
Steps: 1. Edit assignment metadata (description change) | 2. Save successfully | 3. Scroll to "Update Stage" form | 4. Change stage to "InProgress" | 5. Submit stage update
Test Data: Description update: "Updated project scope with more detail" | Stage change: NotStarted → InProgress
Expected Result: First edit completes successfully. Card updates with new description. Stage update form still functional. Stage updates to InProgress. Both changes persist independently. No conflicts between edit and stage operations.

Title: Edit assignment on mobile viewport
Preconditions: 1. Owner logged in | 2. Browser set to 375px width (mobile) | 3. Assignment exists
Steps: 1. Navigate to Project Details on mobile view | 2. Scroll to Assignment section | 3. Tap "Edit Assignment" button | 4. Form displays in mobile-responsive layout | 5. Edit fields | 6. Submit
Test Data: Mobile viewport: 375x667px | Touch interactions | Form fields: freelancerName, description, notes
Expected Result: Edit button tappable. Form card stacks vertically. Input fields full-width. Save/Cancel buttons accessible. Form submits correctly. No horizontal scroll. UI matches Oktawave mobile design patterns.
